an6.105:1.1: bhikkhave bhavā pahātabbā, tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitabbaṃ.
an6.105:1.8: Yato kho bhikkhave bhikkhuno ime tayo bhavā pahīnā honti, imāsu ca tīsu sikkhāsu sikkhitasikkho hoti:
an6.105:1.9: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu acchejji taṇhaṃ, vivattayi saṃyojanaṃ, sammā mānābhisamayā antam akāsi dukkhassā
